crossRefs.note: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

translations.web: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
translations.bsb: Take the garment of him who posts security for a stranger; get collateral if it is for a foreigner.
translations.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
translations.asv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; And hold him in pledge that is surety for a foreign woman.
